query: SELECT cm.slug as moduleSlug, cm.title as moduleTitle, cm.totalLessons as declaredLessons, COUNT(cl.id) as actualLessons, cm.path FROM course_modules cm LEFT JOIN course_lessons cl ON cl.moduleId = cm.id GROUP BY cm.id ORDER BY cm.path, cm.orderIndex;
